lead_raw_text:
The structure of Li2AlAg crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing eight atoms—Li4Al2Ag2—distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Al and Ag each adopt a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 geometric neighbors, while Li has 16 neighbors. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations reveal corner- and face-sharing between Al and Li polyhedra, and edge- and face-sharing between Al and Ag polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all eight sites.
